Messages.Author: bwr...@mail.com
Messages.Body:
On Mar 10, 5:55 pm, Chris Berger <ark...@ugcs.caltech.edu> wrote:

> On Mar 10, 4:20 pm, Thrall of Arika <christopher.ack...@amec.com>

> > Regaining the Upper Hand
> > Esteem
>
> No.  Just terrible.  Especially Esteem.  Seems like more often than
> not, someone's just going to play them to cycle them out of the
> Imperator hand, if at all.

Which would be my biggest concern with building an Imperator deck...
making sure that the cards will cycle, because there's no reason to
assume that the players will cycle cards that are useless. After all,
it will cost them an MPA or DPA to do it, and it might expose
something really good for their prey or really bad for them. If you
don't have a second MPA to spend, you'll never get first grab of any
good masters you turn up by discarding... so you'll probably end up
spending your DPA as well just to discard the card before your prey
gets it (unless, of course, you used a DPA to discard the original
useless card... at which point, why are you giving another player
first grab at a fresh card? I see the DPA option as purely
preventative... use it to remove dangerous cards.)

This is why you shouldn't have three of certain cards like clan
hosers... if that clan isn't playing, they'll just take over the
Imperator hand and jam it... even with two copies it could really shut
down that element if they come up early. Too many cornercase cards
can do likewise. I'm surprised that there wasn't a rule for an
autoclear of the Imperator hand... something like "if play goes around
the table (once? twice?) without a card from the Imperator hand being
played, discard it and draw a new hand".

Adding Rumours of Gehenna and The Parthenon to the Imperator deck to
assure multiple MPAs will be available could be a good idea. Another
good thing might be limiting the number of Masters... the better
chance people have of drawing something they can use (without needing
anything special like a second MPA) the more likely people will be to
cycle useless cards in the Imperator hand.

Anyways, getting back to the two cards I quoted above... Esteem is
probably okay. As a modifier it doesn't really cost anything to use
here, someone will eventually take a (D) action at the player with the
edge (without going out of their way) and probably take advantage of
it. Regaining the Upper Hand, though... I wouldn't go with it. I can
see that sitting there for the rest of the game because no one wants
to spend an action on it. Even if it does become The Right Thing(tm),
it will probably spend an awfui long time just sitting there. It's
probably okay if it was the only card in the deck likely to do that,
but that's unlikely if you have hosers or cornercase cards.

Brent Ross

I don't see it being fun at all, and in fact goes against the entire
spirit of the Storyline. The Imperator is being chosen due to the fact
that the Anarchs are causing so much trouble of late, in addition to
all the Sabbat goings-on.

Remember that there are going to be a lot of titled vampires about. So
a lot of vampires are not going to be able to use anarch cards in the
first place, with no way to go anarch.

Frankly, I would bow out if such an ID was brought to the table to
play.

Now, if you are wanting to run a similar tournament, but for anarchs,
that's completely different. My group will likely see about modifying
the idea of this tournament to come up with one for Sabbat, and
choosing a Regent. Pretty much the exact same thing, only with the
main Sabbat clans, and with the title of Regent as the prize, with a
Regent Deck built with various Sabbat goodness. I'm sure an Anarch
version could be done as well.

Perhaps I'm one of the few, but I actually want to play Camarilla,
with Camarilla politics and in-fighting.

Chris, Thrall of Arika
